QuestInfo.name: Kiridu's Calling
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# suggested that you take your Mount and go see #b#p1102002#, the Mount Instructor,#k saying that your Mount may be in trouble.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# suggested that you take your Mount and go see #p1102002#, the Mount Instructor, saying that your Mount may be in trouble.

0.0: #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainer#k is looking for you. It seemed like there was a problem with your Mount. I'm not sure what exactly, but I suggest you take your Mount and go see #p1102002# at once.

yes.0: I overheard something about your Mount. It could be weakening! If you want more details, go see #p1102002# now!

no.0: #p1102002# didn't seem too happy. I think it has something to do with your Mount. This is all I can tell you right now, but if you wish to continue riding your Mount without seeing him, I can't stop you.

1.0: It's been awhile, #h0#. I've heard that you are growing stronger as the days go by. It's a great thing to hear... But it's causing an issue on your mount.

npc.0: You haven't gone to #b#p1102002##k yet? Hm, it seemed rather urgent. You're only hurting yourself by wasting time.
